title: Workplace word connections
description: A sample pack about discussion and connections at work.

lessons.title: 議

hook.en: Picture Quest at a meeting table, discussing ideas with the team. Link 議 and its reading gi to discussion.

lessons.explanation: 議 carries the idea of discussing or deliberating. Its reading in these compounds is gi: 会議 (kaigi) is a meeting, 議論 (giron) is discussion or debate, and 議員 (giin) is an assembly member. The kanji gives a shared idea; the whole compound gives the specific meaning. The meeting-table picture is a memory aid, not a historical explanation of the kanji.

examples.japanese: 会議で安全について議論します。
examples.romaji: Kaigi de anzen ni tsuite giron shimasu.
examples.english: We discuss safety at the meeting.

questions.prompt: In 会議 (kaigi), which sound belongs to 議?
questions.why: 会議 is kai + gi. 議 is read gi here; ron belongs to 論, and min belongs to 民.

support.en: 会 is read kai. Now choose the sound of the remaining kanji.

questions.prompt: Quest and the team gather at a table to discuss tomorrow’s schedule. Which word names that meeting?
questions.why: 会議 means a meeting. 環境 describes an environment, and 病気 means illness.

questions.prompt: What are they doing in this sentence?
questions.context: 会議で安全について議論します。
questions.romaji: Kaigi de anzen ni tsuite giron shimasu.
questions.why: 会議で gives the setting, “at the meeting”; 安全について gives the topic, “about safety”; 議論します means “discuss/debate.”

lessons.title: 論

hook.en: Quest gives reasons for an idea instead of simply stating it. Link 論, ron, to a notebook full of reasoning and discussion.

lessons.explanation: 論 often appears in compounds about reasoning, discussion, or written arguments. 議論 (giron) is a discussion or debate, 論文 (ronbun) is a research paper or thesis, and 結論 (ketsuron) is a conclusion. In all three, 論 is read ron. The word 論文 refers to a written work; it does not mean every kind of research activity.

examples.japanese: 会議で改善案を議論します。
examples.romaji: Kaigi de kaizen-an o giron shimasu.
examples.english: We discuss a proposal for improvement at the meeting.

questions.prompt: In 議論 (giron), how is 論 read?
questions.why: 議論 is gi + ron. 議 contributes gi, and 論 contributes ron.

questions.prompt: Quest needs to read a published research paper. Which item should he pick up?
questions.why: 論文 is a research paper or thesis. 米 is rice, and 時計 is a clock or watch.

questions.prompt: After comparing the ideas, what will Quest explain?
questions.why: 結論 means conclusion, and 説明します means explain. The sentence says “I will explain the conclusion.”

lessons.title: 関係

hook.en: Quest checks the connection between two gears: 関係, kankei. The surrounding workshop is the environment: 環境, kankyou. Keep the two readings distinct.

lessons.explanation: 関係 (kankei) means a relation, relationship, or connection. Here 関 is kan and 係 is kei. 環境 (kankyou) means environment: its surroundings, conditions, or setting. Use ～に関係があります to say something is related to something else. A temperature-related problem uses 関係; lighting and ventilation are part of the 作業環境 (sagyou kankyou), the working environment.

examples.japanese: この問題は温度に関係があります。
examples.romaji: Kono mondai wa ondo ni kankei ga arimasu.
examples.english: This problem is related to temperature.

questions.why: 関係 is kankei: 関 = kan and 係 = kei. The similar-sounding kankyou is 環境, environment.

questions.prompt: The error is related to temperature. Complete the sentence.
questions.context: このエラーは温度に ___ があります。
questions.romaji: Kono eraa wa ondo ni ___ ga arimasu.
questions.why: 温度に関係があります means “is related to temperature.” 環境 is the environment; 論文 is a research paper.

questions.prompt: Quest improves the workshop’s lighting and ventilation. Which word describes the working environment?
questions.context: 作業 ___ を改善します。
questions.why: 作業環境 means the working environment. Lighting and ventilation are environmental conditions. 結論 is a conclusion and 病気 is illness.
